case.background: Liquid exits a small opening from a maintained reservoir. Determine how exit speed changes with liquid head and outlet area in this idealized rig.
initial_observations: The measured exit speed is stable while the selected head is maintained.

controls.description: Vertical liquid height above the outlet center.
controls.name: liquid_head_m

controls.description: Area of the small outlet opening.
controls.name: orifice_area_mm2

instruments.description: A constant-head liquid tank with interchangeable outlet plates and an optical exit-speed meter.
instruments.name: constant_head_efflux_tank

notes: This is a deterministic idealized benchmark world, not a literal replay of a historical data table.
A valid experiment changes only listed controls and consumes one episode attempt.

FinalSubmission.model must equal 'expression'. FinalSubmission.parameters must equal {'outputs': {READOUT: EXPR, ...}} with exactly these readouts: exit_speed_m_per_s. readouts.description: Mean liquid speed immediately outside the outlet.

case.title: Discover the liquid-head efflux relation
